result.label: Own-price elasticity, 330ml can
result.rationale: Smallest, most impulse-driven format; set near the elastic end of the brief's -0.8 to -2.5 CPG range.
result.reference: Context only, not a fitted value. Published scanner-data studies report a wide spread of soft-drink own-price elasticities, with household scanner data tending to be more elastic (https://pure.psu.edu/en/publications/a-meta-analysis-of-us-food-demand-elasticities-to-detect-the-impa/). Observational elasticities can also differ from experimental ones (https://www.msi.org/working-paper/observational-price-variation-in-scanner-data-cannot-reproduce-experimental-price-elasticities/), so the value carries a range that drives the sensitivity bands.

recommendations: [R1] Prioritize Goal-seek option 1 for implementation, since it has the highest modeled Aurora gross profit (4.focal.gp.value, call_0006) among evaluated options while increasing volume relative to baseline (4.focal.volume.value vs 0.focal.volume.value, call_0006).

[R2] Use the focal bridge for Goal-seek option 1 to guide execution: protect the positive contribution from price and promo (4.focal_bridge.price and 4.focal_bridge.promo, call_0006; supports [R1]) and monitor the downside risks from volume and cogs (4.focal_bridge.volume and 4.focal_bridge.cogs, call_0006; supports [R1]).
answer.summary: Goal-seek option 1 delivers the highest projected Aurora gross profit while keeping volume within the specified tolerance. Under Goal-seek option 1, modeled Aurora gross profit is 257481.76539644136 INR per week (4.focal.gp.value, call_0006), versus 227763.9046622554 INR in the Baseline – current Aurora pricing & promo (0.focal.gp.value, call_0006). Aurora volume under Goal-seek option 1 is 10141.158096424817 units (4.focal.volume.value, call_0006), compared with 9059.824006473373 units in the baseline (0.focal.volume.value, call_0006). The improvement in gross profit versus baseline is explained in the bridge mainly by higher effective price and incremental promo support for Aurora, partly offset by volume softness and higher costs: price and promo together contribute positively (4.focal_bridge.price and 4.focal_bridge.promo, call_0006), while the volume and cogs components are negative (4.focal_bridge.volume and 4.focal_bridge.cogs, call_0006). This scenario depends on the assumption set A-001, A-002, A-003, A-004, A-005, A-006, A-007, A-008, A-009, A-012, A-013, A-014a, A-014b, A-014c, A-014d, A-015, A-016, A-017, A-017b, A-018, A-019, A-020, A-021, A-022 and A-023 (4.assumption_ids, call_0006).
